response.answer: Julia Leininger is a leading researcher on social cohesion in Africa, defining it as trust, inclusive identity, and cooperation. Her work proposes new measurement methods. She collaborates with IDOS.

results.title: Julia Leininger's Post - Social Cohesion - LinkedIn
results.content: A real Christmas present 😊 🎄 Great work with IDOS colleagues German Institute of Development and Sustainability (IDOS) Julia Leininger Armin von Schiller Charlotte Fiedler Christoph Sommer Karina Mross Daniel Nowack Christoph Strupat Christopher Wingens https://lnkd.in/gsDuWFj7 On contents: 💡 We provide a lean definition of Social Cohesion as a multi-faceted phenomenon encompassing 3 attributes: Trust, Inclusive Identity and Cooperation for the Common Good 💡 We propose a measurement of social cohesion in Africa, relaying on household data from Afrobarometer and expert data from V-Dem 💡 There is a relatively high variation of social cohesion attributes across African countries, especially for inclusive identity 💡 The cooperation score showed minimal variation over time, whereas the trust and identity scores exhibited significantly greater fluctuations 💡 Our cluster analysis indicates the presence of four different constellations of social cohesion in Africa.
